builder.objective: REPAIR V3-06: Add snapshot()/restoreFromSnapshot() to InMemoryExpenseEntryRepository, InMemorySettlementRepository, InMemoryPersistentTaskRepository, InMemoryMemberRepository, InMemoryMembershipRepository and InMemoryHouseholdRepository, and include all of them (plus the sync buffer/cursor state) in the in-memory withTransaction snapshot/restore so any throw rolls back every business table.; Inject the failing repo into the real repository set (e.g. replace repos.contributions/repos.expenses with a throwing implementation before calling repos.syncState.applyDeltas or pullDeltas on the production MaterializingSyncState) and assert the cursor did not advance AND every business table (contributions, expenses, settlements, todos, persistent_tasks, members, memberships, households) is unchanged.; Add hostile tests that drive the app-level data-access path: render AppProvider, sign in as a user, and assert cross-tenant reads/writes through the repos exposed by useApp() are rejected with CROSS_TENANT while legitimate member reads/writes succeed (or drive the use-case layer, e.g. completeTodoAtomic).; Allow the invitation-acceptance path to read the invited household and create the invitee's membership (e.g. invitation-token-scoped read + membership creation authorized by the invitation, or a dedicated join use-case), and re-scope from the raw repos on every sign-in (reset reposRef on signOut, or keep the raw repos and wrap exactly once per sign-in) so the callerUserId is always the current user.; Wire the SQLite repos exactly as the factory does in the test (raw SQLite repos + SyncRecording* wrappers + MaterializingSyncState, using the mocked expo-sqlite driver), or export a testable factory path, then prove: remote delta via applyDeltas -> business record readable; local write via the wrapped repo -> getDirtyRecords returns the payload; pushDeltas sends it.; Add a ScopedPersistentTaskRepository (membership check on getByHousehold/create/delete) and scope invitation reads (getByHousehold requires membership; token-based getByLinkToken/getById remain invitation-authorized) or apply equivalent membership checks in the app path.
